title: chore: move CLI options from FullConfigInternal to TestRunOptions

target.summary: filterLastFailed() returns an empty array when no last-run file exists or on read errors, while callers guard on array length. Consequently, running with --last-failed when the previous run had no failures attaches no filter and re-runs the entire test suite instead of running nothing.
notes: filterLastFailed returns an empty array instead of undefined when no last-run file exists or on read errors
checks lastFailedTestIds.length instead of existence, skipping test filter attachment when previous run had zero failures
call site checks lastFailedTestIds.length, omitting options.lastFailedTestIds when previous run had zero failures
